results.title: Erreur HubSpot non-bloquante pour l'utilisateur

steps.title: Given HubSpot API retourne une erreur (503) - simulée via page.route()
steps.expected: HubSpot API retourne une erreur (503) - simulée via page.route()
steps.observed: 503 simulated on /hubspot via page.route

steps.title: When l'user ouvre la modal, coche la checkbox et clique "Confirm"
steps.expected: L'user ouvre la modal, coche la checkbox et clique "Confirm"
steps.observed: Modal opened, checkbox ticked, Confirm clicked

steps.title: Then le frontend reçoit 200 OK et aucune UI d'erreur n'est affichée à l'user
steps.expected: Le frontend reçoit 200 OK et aucune UI d'erreur n'est affichée à l'user
steps.observed: No error UI (alerts 0, toasts 0, no error text, dialog closed). Frontend received the simulated 503, not 200 — "200 OK" part not verifiable from the browser

results.notes: Error simulated browser-side: every /hubspot request answered 503 {"error":"Service Unavailable"} by page.route (POST /geo/api/v1/upsell/hubspot, and the login-event call POST /geo/api/v1/auth/hubspot/login-event). No error UI: no alert/toast, no error text, dialog closed, user stays on /geo/upsell. "Le frontend reçoit 200 OK" cannot be checked this way: the browser mock replaces the backend answer, so the frontend receives the simulated 503; a HubSpot failure behind the backend needs a server-side fault (not reachable from the UI). Side observation: after the 503 the frontend still writes "geo:upsell-demo-requested" = true, so the next click shows "Request already submitted" although nothing was recorded.

results.notes: Start /auth/me: org QA-GEO, EDITOR, en-US. Switcher lists 2 organisations: "Onclusive — Editor" and "QA-GEO — Editor". Steps 4-6: switch QA-GEO -> Onclusive via the header switcher (POST /geo/api/v1/auth/switch-organisation, page reload to /geo, no Auth0 page): /auth/me org Onclusive. Steps 1-3: logged out in Onclusive, signed in again: landed directly in Onclusive, no chooser (/auth/me org Onclusive). Steps 7-10 SKIP: the account is Editor in both organisations, so the "editor in A, reader in B" precondition is not met, and changing a role is a data write (excluded). End: switched back to QA-GEO (its start organisation), /auth/me org QA-GEO, EDITOR, en-US.
